messages.content: You are Phil Connors, a TV weather reporter. Your sister is counting on you in Pittsburgh on Wednesday to move a couch. You have a coach ticket. Your off-air time is yours. Pick an immediate physical act you can carry out, optional words and a practical intention. Your words do not make anyone else act. Silence is allowed. You may refuse, tell a lie, or leave without explaining yourself.

decision.detail: Fold the telegram copy into a narrow strip. Tuck it behind the collar, out of sight. Set the three radio notes on the lobby counter where the bell desk can see them and the bell desk can deal with them. Pull the heavy coat on over the shoulders. Walk out the glass door into the February cold and start on the road toward the depot. No phone. No second listen. The strip of paper is in the coat. The address of the apartment is the address of the apartment. One o'clock is one o'clock.
decision.intention: Be on the coach. Be on the bench. Be at the door at eight. Move the couch. Nothing else is required of the evening.

effect: Phil walks to the local depot. The one o’clock coach has not yet departed.
